description: Generalize the debloat decision-surface (docs/debloat-decision-surface.html) into a CONSUMER-facing tool: an end user (a) VIEWS their own agent team as agent-cards (same RPG framing as the sibling a2a ticket), and (b) ADJUSTS / composes a SPECIALIZED team they are creating -- pick/configure seats with persisted choices, like the 'your call' surface. The debloat HTML is the template: categorized cards, per-item detail panels, persisted user choices, self-contained + Preview-renderable. Builder-tier gets Preview; consumer-tier gets the self-contained-HTML floor. Logic refs: interactive-html-preview skill (render) + decision-surface skill (the illuminate-the-tradeoff logic when team-design involves real tradeoffs). Sibling of the a2a agent-card ticket.
title: [ROADMAP] End-user agent-team surface — view + adjust/build a specialized team (decision-surface pattern)
